groups.why: Both rows target the same Excel Upload Validation messages (Sales Site/Project/Model) under the same multi-item error condition and expect every real cause shown per row and item, word for word.
Both rows click the same Excel Form button and expect the template file to download right away with no popup.
This rule treats the popup as the default and makes the no-popup case a user decision, so its expected result differs from the no-popup download rows.
Only this row checks that the template contains no data.
Only this row checks the template's 2-row merged header, matching AS-IS.
Only this row checks the template bucket unit (Monthly) and that M0~M12 are blank.
Only this row checks, before any search, that the template's input bucket follows the Main Period.
Only this row checks the Search action inside the Excel Form popup, which is a different element.
Both rows upload a file whose header does not match the template and expect the upload to be blocked with no save and a notice to the user.
Both rows upload after changing a template column name (Division→Div) and expect a user-facing notice plus a limit of one attached file.
Both rows press OK after uploading a file with error rows and expect the 2-step upload window to block the save and show the error-row block message.
This row checks pressing OK after a successful upload and expects the data saved to the DB, a different state from the error case.
Only this row checks the MSG00684 confirm box when the window is cancelled or closed after a clean check but before saving.
Only this row checks the "Please Input QTY" message when the quantity is missing.
This row checks uploading and saving the Key and Period From/To columns along with per-row messages, which is a different set of elements from the other message rows.
